title: Ebola cases reach more than 500
summary: In tonight's programme, the number of Ebola cases have hit 550 and WHO chief praises neighbouring Uganda for its reponse to the outbreak. In Nigeria, the military says that it has rescued over 400 women and children from Boko Haram extremists after they were abducted in May. And coutdown to the World Cup, but some africans are facing visa problems.
